title: I Made ChatGPT Sell My Junk (4 Prompts) 😳
description:
Heyy 👋

Here's the full ChatGPT selling setup you asked for 🫣
👉 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IgAkxy7zP-L2UAwTRgHZcze4aiZ_ckK7BFxdnme2kfQ/edit?usp=sharing

Do the first two prompts today, photograph 5 things you never use and let it price them 👀

If you get stuck anywhere, drop a comment and I'll help you out 💜

— Aashi 💕
